junction.config.baseBranch: Base branch that other branches are compared against. Empty detects develop, main or master.
junction.config.branchSort: Sort order of branches in the tree.
junction.config.groupByFolder: Group branches into folders by their name prefix (feature/...).
junction.config.commitLimit: Number of commits shown under a branch before 'Load more'.
junction.config.bitbucketServers: Self-hosted Bitbucket servers used to build pull request URLs.
